Sanford's Saturday Social Ride

Sanford, FL · Historic Downtown · Road

Sanford's Saturday Social Ride is a road group ride in Sanford, FL. It rolls every Saturday at 7:30 am from Bicikleta Bike Shop. About 28 miles, 15–17 mph and 17–19 mph groups.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sanford's Saturday Social Ride group ride

Shop ride around the Lake Monroe loop, 28 miles in two pace groups. Route is on Ride with GPS. The shop also runs a monthly recumbent ride and a monthly gravel night ride.
